text:
Ava (CS): quick capture — onboarding cohort B surfaced 7 asks about per-route cost visibility and 3 about token estimation when composing prompts. put raw notes in the CS board: https://notion.redwood/signal-pulse :eyes:
Diego (CS Ops): got it. do we have ARR impact / renew risk for any of those accounts?
Samir (Solutions): main pattern — customers want a preview of expected cost before a run, especially for long prompts. affects trial->paid for a couple mid-market trials.
Elena (PM): can you paste one concrete example so we can scope? also please tag with onboarding + billing in the board.
Ava (CS): pasted sample below:
```
customer: "BetaRetail"
ask: "preview cost when composing prompt on console"
impact: "trial conversion risk if cost looks high"
notes: "wants per-route estimate for multi-turn flows"
priority_suggested: "P2"
```
Maya (Eng): implementation thought: add a pre-run estimator that uses model avg tokens + prefix cache heuristics. UI hook on compose modal. rough estimate: small PoC 1 sprint, product polish 2 sprints.
Elena (PM): thanks — I'll make a ticket. tagging @Maya for tech estimate and @Diego for customer risk tags.
ProductBot: New ticket created RW-8421 "Per-route cost preview" — assignee: @Maya — https://jira.redwood/browse/RW-8421
Diego (CS Ops): please add a "renewal-risk" flag on the Jira and include estimated MRR at risk. also request a "customer quote" field so PMs can use verbatim feedback.
Ava (CS): added customer quote and a quick churn-risk note in the ticket comments. I'll surface in onboarding huddle Friday.
Samir (Solutions): suggestion — bundle estimator with a console toggle (preview on/off) for Dedicated customers to avoid noise. could be a lower-effort incremental rollout.
Elena (PM): good idea. I'll triage RW-8421 into backlog and put it on the onboarding-sprint candidate list. thanks all :thumbsup:
Ava (CS): will follow up with BetaRetail to confirm they see the Jira entry and ask for any clarifying details before Fri huddle.
Maya (Eng): ping me if you get a sample prompt that reproduces the worst-case token counts, helps with estimate.
Elena (PM): noted — adding label: onboarding, billing, renewal-risk, engineering-effort-estimate. closing loop for now.
